title: FACAM: Design and Optimization of A Compact Energy Efficient FeFET-Based Analog Content Addressable Memory
problem: Existing CAM designs focus on discrete binary/multi-bit values; analog CAMs for continuous value search are rare, limiting density and energy efficiency.
motivation: Analog CAMs enable higher density associative search for applications requiring continuous values, with FeFET technology offering compact and efficient implementation.
method: FACAM uses two-phase search with 2FeFET-1T cell: FeFETs set matching range location and width. Matchline precharging integrated into in-cell search. Adaptive scheme early-terminates second phase for energy savings.
key_novelty: Compact FeFET-based analog CAM cell with two-phase search mechanism and adaptive early-termination for energy efficiency.
contributions: Single-input 2FeFET-1T ACAM cell with configurable matching range
Two-phase search scheme improving energy efficiency
Matchline voltage swing reduction via in-cell search integration
Adaptive early-termination for further energy optimization

metrics.speedup: 2.14x vs. 2FeFET ACAM in deep forest accelerator
metrics.accuracy: functional in deep random forest accelerator

limitations: Evaluation limited to random forest accelerator; scalability to large search databases and other workloads not explored.
primary_theme: FeFET-based analog CAM for efficient search
